changelog: v1.3.0 — The ChatGPT queue now lives on the server: CVs being prepared, questions to answer and conversations to delete are kept in the TailorResume database. The server builds each CV the moment ChatGPT finishes, so closing the browser or the extension never loses finished work, and unfinished work continues after the browser is opened again. Applied / Reported / Skipped jobs are closed by the server itself.
